convert_stable_diffusion_controlnet_to_o: convert a stable diffusion controlnet pipeline to ONNX format with text encoder, unet, vae encoder, and vae decoder models
run_convert_models_sd1: run the convert_models function to export SD 1.x controlnet pipeline models to ONNX with fp16 support
run_convert_models_sd_xl: run the convert_models function with sd_xl flag to export SD XL controlnet pipeline to ONNX format
optimize_onnx_graph: optimize an ONNX graph by cleaning up nodes, folding constants, and topologically sorting the graph
create_UNet2DConditionControlNetModel: create a UNet2DConditionControlNetModel wrapper that merges multiple controlnet outputs with a UNet for ONNX export
